split.group_rule: known = scenarios present in train; heldout = test-only scenarios

seeds.comment: no random sampling in this run

acceptance: full acceptance: initial state, every event consumed, terminal state; no skipping

invalid_traces.labelling: independent: derived from retry_service.py source semantics, not from any evaluated FSM

cpg_rca.entrypoint: RetryService.execute (resolved by name; Joern ids are not stable)
cpg_rca.event_cleaning: events normalized with src/online/trie_matcher.normalize_text (the online-stage runtime policy; offline artifacts unchanged)

log_to_code.note: oracle line compared with CPG CALL node LINE_NUMBER of every template-matched call id

PRINS.alphabet_encoding: canonical messages mapped to whitespace-free ids E0000.. (MINT input format)

LogSynthFSM.type: log-based (train traces -> regex parsing -> LLM State Discovery FSM)
LogSynthFSM.scope: FSM stage only (not the synthesis / anomaly-detection pipeline)
